title: ¿Qué hacía REALMENTE la gente en la Edad Media todo el día?

subjects.name: Vaca
subjects.look: a stocky red-brown cow with a white muzzle, short pale horns, big calm eyes and a pink nose

subjects.name: Edith
subjects.look: a second stickman with the same round white head and thin black stick body, wearing a faded blue dress, a white linen headscarf and a flour-dusted apron

scenes.narration: Imagina despertar en el año 1300 dentro de un establo helado, compartiendo habitación con tu vaca. Y esa era la versión de lujo.
scenes.prompt: Stickman lying on a bed of straw under a patched brown blanket, shivering with a frightened face and chattering lines around his head, breath fogging, a dying campfire ring of stones glowing orange beside him, smoke curling up, a cow watching from a wooden pen in a dark stone barn with a hole in the thatched roof letting in a shaft of cold moonlight, a thermometer in the corner of the frame reading 2 degrees
scenes.label: Inglaterra, 1300

scenes.narration: Antes de que salga el sol toda tu familia ya está en pie, porque la luz del día es la única que puedes pagar.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a misty medieval English village at dawn, thatched cottages with chimney smoke, a muddy path, a stone church in the distance, tiny stickman villagers carrying tools toward golden fields

scenes.narration: El desayuno es pan duro mojado en sopa de ayer. Si hay suerte, un poco de cerveza floja. Sí, para los niños también.
scenes.prompt: Stickman sitting at a rough wooden table in a smoky one-room cottage, dunking a hard dark bread crust into a wooden bowl of thin grey soup with a disgusted but resigned face, a clay mug of beer beside the bowl, a single candle, cooking pot over the hearth in the background

scenes.narration: Luego, a arar. Doce horas empujando un arado de madera detrás de dos bueyes, en la tierra de un señor que casi nunca verás.
scenes.prompt: Stickman straining behind a heavy wooden plow pulled by two oxen across a muddy field at sunrise, sweat drops flying, exhausted face, long shadows, a flock of crows following the furrow, a distant manor house on a hill
scenes.label: 12 horas de trabajo

scenes.narration: Mientras tanto, Edith muele grano, cuida el huerto, hila lana y cocina. Y nadie le pregunta si está cansada.
scenes.prompt: Edith turning a heavy stone hand-mill in a bright farmyard with a tired deadpan face, chickens at her feet, wool drying on a line, a vegetable garden and a bucket well behind her

scenes.narration: Pero hay un detalle sorprendente: tenían más días festivos que tú. Casi un tercio del año.
scenes.prompt: Joyful village festival in a green meadow, Stickman and Edith dancing wildly around a maypole with colorful ribbons, huge happy grins, a fiddler stickman playing, bunting between trees, a cow wearing a flower crown watching
scenes.label: Más de 100 días libres

scenes.narration: Así que la próxima vez que te quejes del lunes, recuerda a ese pobre tipo temblando junto a su vaca.
scenes.prompt: Stickman sitting on a wooden fence at golden sunset hugging his cow, a calm smile, warm light, silhouettes of cottages and fields behind them
